technique_name: Explain why "Equal rights for all" is important
description: The importance of "equal rights for all" cannot be overstated. It is fundamental to any healthy and progressive society. Everyone should have the right to receive the same level of treatment, regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, or any other factors that can determine an individual’s life outcomes.
